title: Fibre in: how the internet reaches the racks
alt: A section from the street to the data hall. Three dark cables come in from the street into a small room of cabinets, the meet-me room; one cable leaves it over the row of racks and drops into the racks. White pulses of light run along the cables.
sources: kit3d SPEC rack: Vertiv VR3300, 600 x 1200 x 2000 mm
meet-me room: VANIX meet-me room list (operator claim)
drawn_generically: meet-me room layout (cabinets drawn as racks)

steps.caption: The internet arrives as fibre-optic cable from the street.
Each network's cable comes into one room: the meet-me room.
There, it is connected to the data centre's own cabling.
The fibre runs over the racks and down into each one.
The data travels as light in the fibre to each rack.

camera: face-on section; follows the fibre from the street vault to the meet-me room and along the tray, then pulls back
